-- STEP 1: Create temp_master_weight

-- TEMP TABLE FOR weight
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_weight;

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_weight AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       (fasting_subsample_2_year_mec_weight * 2.0 / 4.0) AS survey_weight
FROM nhanes.glu_g
WHERE fasting_subsample_2_year_mec_weight IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       (fasting_subsample_2_year_mec_weight * 2.0 / 4.0) AS survey_weight
FROM nhanes.glu_h
WHERE fasting_subsample_2_year_mec_weight IS NOT NULL;


-- STEP 2: Create temp_psu_stratum

-- TEMP TABLE FOR PSU and Stratum
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_psu_stratum;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_psu_stratum AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       masked_variance_pseudo_psu AS masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
       masked_variance_pseudo_stratum AS masked_variance_pseudo_stratum
FROM nhanes.demo_g
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       masked_variance_pseudo_psu AS masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
       masked_variance_pseudo_stratum AS masked_variance_pseudo_stratum
FROM nhanes.demo_h;


-- STEP 3: Create final weight+design table
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS weight_design;
CREATE TABLE weight_design AS
SELECT 
    s.respondent_sequence_number,
    s.masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
    s.masked_variance_pseudo_stratum,
    w.survey_weight
FROM temp_psu_stratum s
INNER JOIN temp_master_weight w
  ON s.respondent_sequence_number = w.respondent_sequence_number;

  AND "cerad_score_trial_3_recall" IS NOT NULL

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age Group
-- Categorize age into '<70 years' and '≥70 years'
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age_group AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."age_in_years_at_screening" < 70 THEN '<70 years'
           WHEN f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 70 THEN '≥70 years'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "age_group"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex
-- Extract sex information
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race/Ethnicity Group
-- Map race/ethnicity to specified categories
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race_ethnicity_group AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin_w_nh_asian" = 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin_w_nh_asian" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin_w_nh_asian" = 'Non-Hispanic Asian' THEN 'non-hispanic asian'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin_w_nh_asian" = 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican-american'
           ELSE 'others'
       END AS "race_ethnicity_group"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 HbA1c (%)
-- Extract HbA1c values
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hba1c AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."glycohemoglobin" AS "hba1c"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.5 Digit Symbol Score
-- Extract digit symbol score values
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_digit_symbol_score AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."digit_symbol_score"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  tag."age_group",
  ts."sex",
  tre."race_ethnicity_group",
  th."hba1c",
  tdss."digit_symbol_score"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age_group tag ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = tag."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_sex ts ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = ts."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_race_ethnicity_group tre ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = tre."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_hba1c th ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = th."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_digit_symbol_score tdss ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = tdss."respondent_sequence_number";
